links.comparator_used: Unguided LLM output with no citation verification (C1 condition in the 640-run ablation)
links.outcome: Type I (fabricated citation) and Type II (wrong-topic citation) hallucination rates
links.effect: Live PMID verification alone (C3) gave 0.0% Type I and 0.0% Type II, versus 95.9% Type II for unguided output. The full VaaS protocol (C4) gave 0.0% Type I and 6.5% Type II, a >14-fold reduction.
links.tradeoff: The full pipeline cost less than ~$1 per comprehensive gene review. No latency or new failure modes are reported in the abstract.
links.quote: live PMID verification alone (C3) eliminated both error types entirely (0.0%/0.0%)

design_hint: live PMID citation verification and multi-layer output validation guardrails
